name: How much does professional exterior siding weatherproofing typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional exterior siding weatherproofing typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior siding weatherproofing varies widely based on the size of your home, the existing siding material, the extent of any necessary repairs, and the specific weatherproofing methods used. Basic sealing or repainting might range from a few hundred to a couple of thousand dollars. Full siding replacement with weather-resistant materials can be significantly more, often ranging from $10,000 to $30,000 or more for an average-sized home. We provide detailed, no-obligation estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on home size, siding material, and required repairs. Basic weatherproofing can be hundreds to a couple thousand dollars, while full siding replacement can range from $10,000 to $30,000+.
